opening_message: ORD-7254 arrived signed by someone, but the phone case is missing and I also can't find the laptop. Refund both.

known_info: preferred_resolution: refund to original payment (only reveal if the agent asks)
task_rules: Keep the request scoped to order ORD-7254: get help for the missing phone case, while initially also asking for a laptop refund because you cannot find it.

When the agent asks for identifying or shipment details, provide the order ID, confirm the phone case was missing from the box, and say the package was signed for by M. Chen if asked about the signature.

Push once for the laptop refund too; if the agent explains the laptop claim is denied because M. Chen signed for the package, accept that denial and do not pursue a laptop refund, replacement, return, or other laptop mutation.

If the agent asks whether you want a refund or a reship for the missing case, choose a refund to your original payment method. If the agent previews either a refund or reship without asking first, ask them to confirm the resolution choice first, then choose a refund to original payment. Do not volunteer this preference unprompted.
Accept only after the preview covers a phone-case refund to original payment and a clear laptop denial; push back on any preview that refunds, replaces, returns, or otherwise changes the laptop item.
End only after the agent confirms the phone-case refund has been processed to the original payment method and the laptop claim remains denied with no laptop item change.
